title: TIG-CDO Replication Package: Transaction Intent Graph for Composite Defense Orchestration in Microservices Payment Systems
description:
Replication package for “Transaction Intent Graph: Semantic Cross-Layer Defense Orchestration for Microservices Payment Systems” (Rangari, Mishra, Senapati; manuscript under review, 2026). Contains the TIG-CDO component implementations (STC, CLCS, BIM, PSRG, PADO, FDCE), the evaluation harness and follow-up analyses with their machine-readable outputs, the calibration scripts that ground model parameters in public data together with their checked-in outputs, the Kubernetes payment-microservices testbed manifests and service sources, the CSDA scenario definitions, figure-generation code, the companion-survey baselines and cross-dataset validation scripts, and a bundled copy of the Apache-2.0 Nigerian Banking Card Transactions dataset (3.0M records; synthetic, per its dataset card).

The evaluation is a simulation study. In the CSDA configuration comparison (4 attack conditions, 39 replicate runs per configuration) block rates, base false-positive probabilities and detection latencies are configured inputs; the FDCE rule engine (R-11/R-12) is run on simulated traffic and detects 30 of 30 scenarios with 2.43 s mean latency. Component latencies are design targets, not measurements. REPRODUCTION.md maps every table and figure to its command and states which values are verified from a clean copy, archived, or design values.

v1.2.0 corrects the harness false-positive-rate denominator, describes the CSDA grid as the 4 conditions it computes, adds writers for the Figure 2 trajectory and the FDCE grid, and relabels PSRG/PADO latencies; see CHANGELOG.md.

See README.md for the directory map. Bulk third-party datasets are not re-hosted; they are listed below as isDerivedFrom identifiers and documented in data/manifests/.
